account: It is day 0, about 09:02. I came from home to town hall and read the secretary's appointment book. Today's schedule is ordinary: morning correspondence, a 10:00 market walk in the plaza, lunch at home, town accounts at 13:00, tea with the neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. Tomorrow includes a 10:00 grain inspection at the mill. I returned the book to its chest. I asked the secretary about correspondence and unusual news, but have heard no answer yet. The secretary is beside me holding a writable book. The builder has approached town hall carrying a lantern and is now nearby; I do not know why. Several townsfolk have passed near the hall. Nothing I have actually seen or heard yet establishes any unusual activity or secret arrangement. My feeling that something is happening without me remains only a suspicion; I cannot yet identify who might be involved or what their purpose might be.
